senses.gloss:
Khinda(ndi)ka
jy. probably the first to write the Tāja(ji)ka in Roman an. Arabic system; ref. to by Nṛsiṁha a. the beg. of his Hillājatājikā(dīpikā), L. 4095; in Rāmeśvara's Hillājavyākhyā, Peters. IV. p. 60 (Intro. verses 2 an. 3); an. in Samarasiṁha's Tājikatantrasāra or Karmaprakāśa or Manuṣyajātaka, Bomb. Uni. 419. Peters. II. Extr. p. 130. PUL. II. p. 230. RASB. X. 6990.
--Tājakatantra, guru. ref. to by Samarasiṁha a. the original of which his work Tājakatantrasāra is a summary.
